findings.description: CON-SUP-113 requires GET FAULTS to return the last 8 fault reports, and CON-SUP-134 specifies their order and terminator. SYS-SUP-029 requires fault history to survive software and watchdog resets, but SYS-SUP-034 returns only the reports held, at most 8. The set does not require the most recent 8 reports to be retained.
findings.requested_change: Require retention of the most recent 8 fault reports, or all reports when fewer than 8 exist, so GET FAULTS can return them.
